description: This file contains the core business logic for managing events within an event management microservice. It defines the EventService class, which provides methods to create, configure, and retrieve events, handling validation, transformation, database interactions, and error handling. The class also includes placeholders for future Kafka integrations.

classes.name: EventService
classes.description: Implements application business rules for events, providing methods to create, configure, and retrieve event data, with validation, transformation, and error handling.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_event(self, event_data: dict)
methods.description: Creates a new event with validated input data, transforms it for persistence, stores it in the database, and publishes an event creation notification (placeholder).

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] configure_event(self, config_data: dict)
methods.description: Updates the configuration of an existing event, identified by eventId, and publishes a configuration event (placeholder).

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_event(self, event_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves an event by its ID, transforming database data into an API-friendly format.

methods.name: None _publish_event_created(self, event_id: str, data: dict)
methods.description: Placeholder method intended for producing a Kafka message when a new event is created.

methods.name: None _publish_event_configured(self, event_id: str, config: dict)
methods.description: Placeholder method intended for producing a Kafka message when an event is configured.
